name: @nbss/video
description: The product demo film — real screens captured from the running site, cut together with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts NbssDemo out/raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-bitrate 256k && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af "loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11,alimiter=limit=0.75:level=false" -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart out/nbss-demo.mp4 && rm out/raw.mp4
